description:
## Goal

The user-side UX half of dual-track retrieval. Every user message is embedded (no LLM call) and matched against the index. Matches surface as: one-click-enable suggestions for tools/CLI commands (row above or alongside input); auto-render of high-confidence widgets inline in chat; dismissible `show this?` cards for borderline widgets.

## Expected Work

- Client-side embedding + query per research latency budget.
- UI affordance: suggestion row for tools/commands (keyboard + click to enable for the turn).
- UI affordance: inline widget render via the iframe-bridge scoped-render directive.
- Confidence-threshold gating per research spec.
- Telemetry for suggestion conversion rate (enabled vs ignored, helpful vs dismissed).

## Acceptance

- User types `change the audio settings for dictation` → the audio-settings widget renders inline (when a qualifying widget exists and confidence is high).
- User types a conversational message that maps to a tool → a suggestion row appears; one click enables for the turn.
name: agent-inbox-passive-suggestion-surface
title: Build the passive-track UI: tool/command suggestions + widget auto-render
